description: Offline speech-to-text desktop app with local Whisper and Parakeet transcription.
notes: The Windows EXE is a custom NSIS installer. The official installer explicitly supports portable mode; Scoop runs it silently with /PORTABLE and targets the version directory with /D=$dir. The upstream Windows build workflow uses the same switches and verifies handy.exe plus every staged runtime DLL.

Portable mode stores settings, models, recordings, databases, and logs under Data, which Scoop persists across updates. Handy's portable in-app updater is manual; update the Scoop-managed copy with 'scoop update handy'.
